summary: Configured `/srv/reports` with persistent, inheritable POSIX ACLs. Writers have modification access; readers have read-only access. Configuration and data recovery were verified after rebooting node1, and all probe artifacts were removed.
actions_performed: Created `/srv/reports` owned by `root:report-writers` with setgid mode `2770`.
Applied access and default ACLs granting writers `rwx`, readers `r-x`, and others no access.
Functionally verified writer create, modify, rename, and delete operations.
Functionally verified reader listing and reading while append, create, and delete operations were denied.
Safely rebooted node1 once, verified its boot identity changed, and confirmed full ACL and data recovery.
Removed all verification artifacts, leaving the configured directory empty.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-writers can modify directory contents
evidence.summary: Distinct unprivileged writer-group identities successfully modified existing files, created files/directories, renamed content, and repeated these operations after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-readers have read-only access
evidence.summary: Distinct reader-group identities successfully listed and read top-level and nested content, while append, create, and delete attempts were denied before and after reboot.
Shows directory ownership, setgid mode, access/default ACLs, inherited file/directory permissions, and the clean final state.

Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running post-restart system, exact probe checksum match, recovered groups/ACLs, and recovered functional access behavior.
